scientific_integrity: Infinite conclusions follow from explicit substitution identities, greedy-arch characterization, and primitive-substitution frequencies. Computations corroborate, but do not certify, these proofs. All source contributions are credited.
scientific_limitations: Standard multinacci substitution and its zero-starting fixed point only; not all episturmian words or shifts.
Earlier general episturmian return-word theory may implicitly contain portions of the gap-spectrum statement; priority of that subsidiary claim is not asserted.
Independent audit and formal certification have not been performed.
title: A self-similar arch factorization for all multinacci words
